AZ New Bath is a general contractor specializing in residential bathroom remodels. We are passionate about creating exceptional living environments that enhance our clients’ lifestyles. As licensed professionals with over 15 years of experience in the remodeling industry, we approach every project with a commitment to sustainable building practices and a focus on blending traditional techniques with modern technology. Our projects are not only visually stunning, but also environmentally friendly and easy to maintain.

We are dedicated to providing our clients with an unparalleled level of service and quality, and we work closely with them throughout the entire renovation process to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience. Whether you're looking to remodel your bathroom, AZ New Bath is committed to delivering exceptional results that meet your needs and exceed your expectations.

At AZ New Bath, our core value of “Quality & Integrity From Start to Beautiful Finish” is at the heart of everything we do. 
Our talented and licensed design team is dedicated to bringing the vision and individuality of our clients to life in each beautifully designed space.

We believe in delivering an enjoyable experience for our clients, and our reputation is built on our commitment to integrity, exceptional design, cost-effective building methods, timely delivery, and the use of high-quality materials that ensure durability and safety in our homes. We strive to bring your vision to life in a way that is both beautiful and functional, and we are dedicated to delivering results that exceed your expectations.

Bathroom Remodels In The Phoenix and Prescott Area

Whether you're looking to enhance the functionality of your existing bathroom or start from scratch, we can help. We specialize in custom bathroom remodeling and can create a space that is tailored to your unique needs and design preferences. Create a spa-like sanctuary in your home where you can unwind in a soaking tub, simply improve functionality with an updated design, or reconfigure the space to accommodate accessibility - we do it all at AZ New Bath. We specialize in custom bathroom remodeling and can create your dream bathroom based on your personalized lifestyle needs and design taste. Some of our specialties include:

Bathtub and shower installation

Bathroom flooring

Vanity, mirror, and medicine cabinet installation

Shower remodels

Bathroom conversions

No matter what your vision is for your bathroom, AZ New Bath can bring it to life. If you have questions about your bathroom remodel, we encourage you to give us a call. Our team is always happy to answer any questions you may have and help guide you through the process.

Jonathan Sands  Bathroom Remodel
How Much Does it Cost to Remodel a Bathroom?

Remodeling your bathroom can greatly enhance the value of your home. It’s one of the most rewarding areas to remodel in your home because a few small changes can make a big impact on the look and functionality of the space. A bathroom remodel can increase the value of your home while also making your home more enjoyable to live in. 

Whatever your reasons for remodeling, the first question on most homeowners' minds is, “how much does it cost to remodel a bathroom?”

TYPICAL COST OF REMODELING A BATHROOM

A bathroom remodel can be a daunting task for homeowners. This doesn’t have to be the case if you work with the right contractor. A good remodeling contractor will know how to make the most of the space based on your remodeling budget. The average cost of a bathroom remodel will depend on the scope, size, and features of the project.

The typical cost of a small-scale bathroom remodel is around $5,000 to $10,000. This includes minor updates such as new flooring, painting, or fixtures, and more significant changes like adding a new shower or bathtub, changing the room's layout, or adding storage space.

The typical cost of a medium-scale or primary bathroom remodel is around $15,000 to $25,000. A medium-scale update typically involves major upgrades like replacing major bathroom fixtures (i.e. sinks, toilets) as well as redoing plumbing lines.

Once you have an idea of everything that needs to get done to bring your vision to life, the next step is to shop around. It’s always a good idea to get a few quotes from different contractors so you can find the one who will give you the best price while also delivering quality work.

WHY YOU SHOULD REMODEL YOUR BATHROOM

Remodeling your bathroom can help you increase the value of your home, provide more space, and improve your home's appearance and functionality. Many people choose to remodel their bathroom for cosmetic reasons or more practical ones (accessibility). A bathtub to shower conversion can help seniors stay safe while maintaining independence in their homes. A shower conversion is a great way to make bathing more comfortable and safe for elderly folks.

WHAT IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE PART OF A BATHROOM REMODEL?

There are a number of factors that influence the average cost of remodeling your bathroom. The size of the room, the shape of the room, as well as what kind of functionality you're looking to have all play a role in determining the investment needed to remodel your bathroom.

The most expensive remodeling projects are those that require new plumbing, electrical wiring, and or major structural changes to the room. 

The type of material you choose for your new bathroom will impact its price as well. For example, porcelain tile is less expensive than marble but it’s not as durable or easy to maintain. The type of material you choose will also affect installation costs because some materials take longer to install than others. For example, tiles are cheaper but require more time and labor because they must be set individually

HOW TO SAVE MONEY ON A BATHROOM RENOVATION?

If you are looking for ways to save money on a bathroom renovation, then you need to be aware of some of the common mistakes people make when they start the project.

These mistakes could include:

Not planning ahead

Not making sure you have enough funds available before starting the project

Not getting all the necessary permits before starting construction

Starting without a final plan and then making changes

THE IDEAL STRATEGY TO SAVE ON YOUR BATHROOM REMODEL

Home remodeling can be a costly investment, but it doesn't have to be. There are many ways to save on your upcoming projects. One of the most important things is to set a realistic budget for your project. You should know what you can afford before getting started. Your budget should also include money for unforeseen expenses, like additional materials or labor costs that may come up during the project.

You should also consider hiring professional help if you are not experienced in this type of work or if the project is too big for you to handle on your own. Professional help not only saves time but also helps avoid mistakes that could cost more in the long run.

HIRING A PROFESSIONAL CONTRACTOR VS. DIY BATHROOM REMODEL

Hiring a professional for your bathroom remodel ensures that the tile work and plumbing connections are done right. Aside from DIY, your options are to employ a general contractor to handle every aspect of the bathroom remodel or engage a tiler and plumber separately. If you choose the latter, make sure to communicate your expectations to each party explicitly to prevent communication breakdowns. The best option is to hire a general contractor who can oversee the project for you and communicate effectively with each subcontractor.

HIRING A BATHROOM CONTRACTOR IN ARIZONA

A licensed professional contractor in Arizona will have the knowledge and experience to know whether your project will need any permits and, if so, how to obtain them.

Hiring a licensed professional contractor will also give you the advantage of knowing the project is done right. If you're looking to hire a bathroom contractor in Arizona, here are some things you should keep in mind:

If necessary get your HOA approval before starting any construction work

Check whether or not you need to get permits for your construction project

If you want your bathroom to be ADA compliant, make sure that it is at least 36" wide and 60" deep

HOW LONG DOES A BATHROOM REMODEL TAKE?
Jonathan Sands  Bathroom Remodel
How Long Does a Bathroom Remodel Take?

The bathroom is one of the most-used spaces in a home, and it's also the room that needs to be updated most often. A remodel can be time-consuming and expensive. It can also be stressful for homeowners. The best advice is not to let time be the deciding factor in your choice to put off remodeling that much-needed space in your home. Materials and resources for bathroom remodel contractors have come a long way and you have options to make the process take less time, be more cost-effective, and less stressful on you and your family.

CAN YOU REMODEL A BATHROOM IN ONE DAY?

 The scope of the bathroom remodel project is a major factor in determining whether or not you can remodel a bathroom in one day. It’s possible, but if your project requires moving plumbing or involves other contractors like electricians, one day is unlikely to happen. If you’re doing something relatively simple like replacing a bathtub with an acrylic shower, then yes, it’s possible to complete your bathroom remodel in one day.

No matter how quickly you need your bathroom remodeled, many contractors recommend choosing acrylic baths and showers made of non-porous material. Not only is installation quicker than tile, your bath will not chip, crack, or fade. Best of all, acrylic is easy to clean. No more intense scrubbing porous old tiles and grout.

FACTORS THAT AFFECT A BATHROOM REMODEL TIMELINE

A bathroom remodel is a big investment and many homeowners are not sure what they want done until they know the cost and how much time it will take. Here are some important factors to consider when planning your next bathroom remodel.

TYPE OF REMODEL

Bathroom remodel contractors typically can give you a general idea of how long the project will take. But, there are many factors that can affect the timeline. For example, if you are looking to convert your bathtub to a shower and want to add on a toilet, that will affect the timeline. 

Cosmetic remodels are quicker than full renovations because they require less demolition and construction time. A cosmetic remodel is when you make changes to the bathroom without changing any of the walls or flooring. A full renovation is when you change all of those things as well as replace fixtures and appliances in your bathroom.

AVAILABILITY OF MATERIALS

Other factors that may affect the timeline of a bathroom remodel are deciding what style or layout you want. Bath remodeling contractors can help you make those decisions by providing design plans and samples of different materials to choose from. 

Choosing materials that are readily available helps speed up a job vs. waiting on special-order or backorder materials. Homeowners who are more flexible with their design and product choices will help shorten the remodel timeline for the contractor. However, there are certain steps in the process, like laying tile, that can’t be sped up by much due to the amount of detail work it takes to lay individual tiles.

INSPECTIONS

Inspections are required by law for any home remodeling project. The inspections will be done by the city or county building code officials to ensure the work meets all safety codes. Inspections will also be needed for any new plumbing, electrical, heating and cooling systems that may need updating before the project can start.

EXPERIENCE

Hiring the right person for your bathroom remodel is also important to both the amount of time it takes and the quality of the finished product. It can be tempting to want to DIY a home project or hire the company that gives you the cheapest quote. As a homeowner, you know that cheaper is not always better option. It may cause you more trouble in the long run should you have to fix any problems or botched work.

HOW TO CHOOSE THE RIGHT CONTRACTOR FOR YOUR BATHROOM REMODEL

When it comes to remodeling your bathroom, you want to make sure that you are choosing the right contractor for the job. There are a few things that you should be looking for in order to find a contractor that’s right for you.

Experience: One of the most important aspects of finding a contractor is their experience with bathroom remodels. You want to make sure they have experience so that you can be confident that they know what they are doing. It is also important to research online reviews of contractors to see what others have said about them. You can find reviews on sites like Angie's List and Google.

Communication: You want someone who will communicate well with you throughout the entire process. They should answer any questions that arise along the way in a timely manner. They should be able to provide transparency in regards to their work as well as any issues they may run into along the way so that there are no surprises.

WAYS TO EXPEDITE A BATHROOM REMODEL

The majority of homeowners have a bathroom they would like to remodel quickly. However, the process can be time-consuming, costly, and stressful if you’re not prepared. Here are some tips to expedite your bathroom remodeling project.

Hire a contractor with experience in the type of work you need done.

Be available to answer any questions and make any last-minute decisions that might come up during the project.

Avoid making unnecessary last-minute changes that will increase your costs or delay construction work on your home.

HOW TO PREPARE FOR THE UNEXPECTED

Bathroom remodels are a great way to update your space and make it feel fresh. But before you get started, there are some things you need to consider.

Do I need a permit to remodel my bathroom? Do I need to notify my HOA? What do I do if there is an emergency? These are all good questions that every homeowner should ask themselves before they start the process.

The most important thing when planning a bathroom remodel is making sure that it’s done properly and in compliance with local regulations. That’s why it’s important to choose an experienced bathroom contractor in your area.
